# `aitbc config export`

Export the configuration as YAML or JSON, with API keys redacted.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc config export [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--format` | choice | `yaml` | no | Output format |
| `--global` | flag | `false` | no | Export global config |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc config export
```
